'''''Champions of the Force''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. It is the sequel to [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']] and the third volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy]]''. It was first published in paperback by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[October]] [[1994]].
